description: AMF-approved entrepreneurial asset manager (approval GP-07000044), created 2007, wholly owned by Groupe Cyrus. Two business lines: private wealth management for a high-end clientele (including family offices as a client segment) and asset management (European/international equity, flexible international, value-oriented bond strategies). Underwent a leadership transition: Marie Vandermarcq-Saltiel became President in January 2024 and Gilles Constantini was named deputy general director for asset management, as long-standing President Arnaud de Langautier and General Director Olivier Lazar (in role since 2010/2012) stepped back.

fit.reasoning: Fit 60/60 (max): priority segment asset manager (20) + priority market France (15) + multi-asset across equity, flexible international and bond strategies plus a private-wealth line (10) + third-party client money, private and institutional (10) + AMF-regulated, GP-07000044 (5). Trigger 8/25: closest table row is a senior leadership change - a new President (Marie Vandermarcq-Saltiel) took over in January 2024 from a President/General Director pairing in place since 2010/2012 - but this is a President/board-level change rather than a COO/CIO/Head of Ops/Compliance hire as the table specifies, and it is now roughly two years old, so scored well below the 12-point new-hire band. Access 8/15: named current President (Vandermarcq-Saltiel) and deputy general director for asset management (Constantini) identified via press, not yet confirmed reachable.
